reviews.t: This is great stuff. Doesnt irritate my skin or dry it out.
reviews.x: This is great stuff. Doesnt irritate my skin or dry it out.  I buy essential oils and sometime impressions fragrance oils(version of a designer cologne) and I use the Alcohol to make a EDP cologne which is stronger than the department store cologne brands. The longevity is a monster . I like this and I will purchase more.  The dropper come in handy when using smaller bottles.

I purchased this to make my own perfume using resins. I crumbled some high grade amber resin, crumbled myrrh, and crumbled frankensence with drops of pure rose oil. (I use glass roller ball bottles) Shook it up, and let it sit for a couple of days in a cool dark place, and oh my goodness. The perfume is amazing. The resins just disolve, and blend into to alcohol. Its a rich, beautiful golden amber color.  I had this scent in my head for years, but til now when I found the alcohol base, I didn't

reviews.t: I like to create my own perfumes
reviews.x: This is my second purchase of this product. I like to create my own perfumes, and this works great. I blend a few essential oils, then this alcohol, and let it sit for a few weeks, and there, I have my own, unique scent. Fun and simple.

Unfortunately, this product does have quite a strong smell that will alter whatever you add it to. If I change my opinion after using more, I will update this review. But at the moment this seems like it was a waste of money for the purpose I intended it for. Also, I included an image of the ingredients list on the bottle since they don’t include it in the listing which is totally unacceptable. I won’t be buying from this company again
Great product. I use it to dilute and blend fragrance oils to make my own perfume. I run out recently and just re-ordered. Will keep using in the future. Two thumbs up!

reviews.t: Works great for extending life of perfume samples and for diluting perfumes that are too strong.
reviews.x: I get perfume samples from Birchbox, and this lets me make EDT sprays that aren't as overpowering and last longer (by volume, not by scent on arm). I love it! Also works well with essential oils for my stinky homemade mosquito sprays. I also have some perfumes that I love but which are too overpowering for my own sensitive nose, so I like diluting them with this perfumer's alcohol so they are more pleasant to wear.
I ordered this to cut some perfume oil and put it in a spray perfume bottle. It worked perfectly.

claims.text: Many customers use it successfully to make their own perfumes and colognes from essential oils, fragrance oils, and resins.
Several reviewers praise its low or no odor, making it suitable for blending without altering the scent.
Some customers report a strong or unpleasant smell that alters or ruins what they add it to.
A few reviewers complain about the formula, including proprietary ingredients and a batch that soured after a month.
Some users find it oily or thick in consistency.
